messages:
erin: Quick audit: noticed 18 interviews for last week show "interviewer_onboarded=false" in ATS even though they were assigned. Could be the onboarding webhook.

tom: saw one or two in the QA dashboard. The onboarding service had a deploy last night. Might be a race where assignment happens before onboarding flag flips.

faizal: can we identify which interviewer accounts missed the onboarding step? I can run a query and push a remediation task.

erin: yes please run a query for interviewer_id + interview_id where interviewer_onboarded=false and assigned_at IS NOT NULL.

faizal: query result: 18 rows. sample: interviewer U-442 interview I-2319 assigned_at=2026-01-12T09:04:12Z. Looks like the flag write failed with 502.

recruiting-bot: remediation job queued (job=112233). If >5 rows will post CSV to thread.

faizal: ran non-destructive backfill to set interviewer_onboarded=true for those with assignment older than 1h. Dry-run: 18 candidates would change. Command used:
```
python tools/ats_fix_onboard.py --from=2026-01-12 --to=2026-01-13 --dry-run
```

erin: please don't flip anything until tom confirms no deploy rollback will re-run and conflict. Also, we should notify interviewers and include a link to the interviewer cheat-sheet.

tom: confirmed deploy is live and no rollback planned. OK to apply but keep it idempotent and only set flag when null. I'll also add a retry to the onboarding service.

faizal: apply done. job=112233 completed. 18 rows updated. recruiting-bot posted /files/112233/updated_onboard.csv

recruiting-bot: job=112233 complete. 18 updated. CSV: https://internal/files/112233/updated_onboard.csv

erin: thanks. follow-ups: 1) @people-ops can we schedule a 20-min refresher for interviewers on the cheat-sheet + new rubric fields? 2) tom, add a health check to alert if onboarding writes fail >3 times in 15m.

people-ops: will send a 20-min invite for Fri 9am and post the cheat-sheet in #people-ops.

tom: adding healthcheck and a small metric to the onboarding service. will also include a Slack alert to #people-ops when >5 failures in a run.

erin: closing once invite sent and healthcheck alerts in place. :white_check_mark:
